description: The roof, and not the drawing

participation.context: Reported the frame, the money, and the porch, and refused the rest of the letter.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Measured the loaf, asked once, and kept the drawing off her board.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Laid the loaf end to the window, and asked after the children.
participation.name: Alse Pinder

participation.context: Lay on the second volume and was not moved.
participation.name: Gib

relations.note: takes threepence and a measured loaf

story.body: You paid the news of the house in three sentences and kept the children's lines upstairs. Mistress Ansell measured the loaf at a finger and a half and took her threepence. You left Gib on the book.

relations.note: takes threepence and a measured loaf

title: Gave the table the roof and the weather
